Projects/Tasks

- Team Locum (Healthcare Recruitment Agency): Migrated a Ruby on Rails project to ASP.NET Core, with R&D, and integrated MongoDB, Azure Blob, and Hangfire.
- Migration from Ruby on Rails to ASP.NET Core , conducting R&D for seamless transition.
- Managed database operations with MongoDB and handled static files via Azure Blob . File upload via FTP.
- Implemented Hangfire to automated emails (SendGrid API) and created webhooks for syncing with CARAS.
- Created a website and secured APIs for mobile applications.
- Send FCM notifications to mobile devices.

- Managed database operations using MS SQL .
- Skull Unlimited: Integrated AI and email solutions to enhance operational efficiency.
- Integrated ChatGPT API to process Excel files.
- Used Azure Communication Email for email delivery.
- Solomon Labs (CQM): Developed data upload and reporting tools for lab research.
- Implemented bulk data upload via Excel and generated comparison reports using Chart.js and Highcharts.js .
- CWD: Developed reporting tools and migrated ColdFusion functionality to ASP.NET Core.
- Migrated ColdFusion functionality to ASP.NET Core for generating monthly reports using Hangfire for background processing.
- Performed manual deployments via IIS server using RDP
- Loadchief:
- Integrated AngularJS frontend, enhanced API layer, implemented FCM for multiple devices , and synced driver insurance credentials with A4DD.
- Harrison Energy & Mechanical Resource Group (2 Projects):
- Developed drag-and-drop functionality in Angular and added tab functionality using the Tab key for editable controls.
- Streamlined CRUD operations for manufacturers and fixed calculation errors for quote lines to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
